# Fixed nominal superclass result

Owned Base<T> and Core extends Base<String> retain a narrowed input and an
independent FileVisitResult result through an original invokespecial call.
Four frozen caller routes compare 96 cases twice, including nulls, checked and
unchecked failures, staged effects, exact result identity, input cast timing,
and a future subclass that must not redispatch the superclass invocation.
Source and SDK Base profiles compile every recovered unit and audit all original
class/member metadata and roles. Wrong programs and Code-preserving Signature
controls independently test the observer and binding boundary. No file operation
or third-party application code executes.
